Class RulesOverlay

java.lang.Object
view.widgets.RulesOverlay
public final class RulesOverlay extends Object
Full-screen in-game overlay that renders the rules PDF page by page using Apache PDFBox and displays them in a scrollable panel. Click ✕ or the dark backdrop to dismiss.

Pure view utility — no model dependency, no server commands.

      private static void displayOverlay(javafx.scene.layout.StackPane root, List<javafx.scene.image.Image> pages)
      Renders the rules PDF in a scrollable overlay on top of BoardViewController
      Parameters:
      root - the root StackPane of the BoardViewController, used as the parent for the overlay
